subject.title: fix(state): route all record tuple writes through the canonical DO store

question: Can the Worker deployment containing `/internal/state/records/tuples` be completed before any post-merge batch, sweep, or apply writer runs against the new canonical-only path?
rationale: The patch intentionally fails closed when canonical publication is unavailable, so rollout ordering determines whether normal state publication remains available immediately after merge.

options.title: Deploy the Worker first
options.body: Roll out the endpoint before writer workflows use the merged callers, then verify a canonical tuple and projection replay in a real environment.

options.title: Merge and accept a temporary publication pause
options.body: Merge first with explicit operator ownership that record publication may fail closed until the Worker deploy completes.

recommendation.title: Deploy the Worker first
recommendation.body: Roll out the endpoint before writer workflows use the merged callers, then verify a canonical tuple and projection replay in a real environment.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted change and repository workflow guidance both place this operational state-publication path closest to Peter Steinberger.
